tools.description: Run a shell command on the remote host over ssh. Returns stdout, stderr and exit_code; a non-zero exit_code is a normal result, not an error.

session.description: named persistent shell; cwd/env persist across calls with the same name (auto-created, idle-reaped)

tools.name: exec

tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the remote host (max 1 MiB).
tools.name: read_file

tools.description: Write exact bytes to a file on the remote host, creating parent directories.
tools.name: write_file

tools.description: Close a named persistent session opened via exec.
tools.name: session_close

tools.description: Open a local port forward: 127.0.0.1:<local_port> on this machine tunnels to <remote_host>:<remote_port> as seen from the remote host.

remote_host.description: host as resolved from the remote side (default localhost)

tools.name: forward_open

tools.description: Close a port forward opened with forward_open.
tools.name: forward_close
